# Morpheus Hackathon Kit

> Index of Morpheus resources for agents. Morpheus is decentralized AI inference: an OpenAI-compatible API (base URL https://api.mor.org/api/v1) in front of a peer-to-peer network of model providers. Get a key at https://app.mor.org. Use the standard OpenAI SDKs with that base URL. Endpoints: /chat/completions, /embeddings, /audio/speech, /models. There is no Anthropic-style /messages endpoint, no /responses endpoint and no image generation.

## Sweep these first (official llms.txt files)

- [mor.org llms.txt](https://mor.org/llms.txt): main site. Send the header `Accept: text/markdown` for markdown pages
- [GitBook llms.txt](https://gitbook.mor.org/llms.txt): full docs. Add `.md` to any page URL
- [API docs llms.txt](https://apidocs.mor.org/llms.txt): inference API, guides, integrations, reference
- [OpenAPI spec](https://apidocs.mor.org/api-reference/openapi.json)

## Build

- [Quickstart](https://apidocs.mor.org/quickstart.md)
- [Live model list](https://api.mor.org/api/v1/models): IDs are case-sensitive and can contain spaces. `:web` variants include web search
- [Interactive API docs](https://api.mor.org/docs)
- [Tool calling](https://apidocs.mor.org/documentation/guides/tool-calling.md)
- [Vision](https://apidocs.mor.org/documentation/guides/vision.md)
- [Rate limits](https://apidocs.mor.org/documentation/models/rate-limits.md)
- [Pricing](https://apidocs.mor.org/documentation/models/pricing.md)
- [Credits](https://apidocs.mor.org/documentation/getting-started/credits.md)
- [OpenAI Python SDK](https://apidocs.mor.org/documentation/integrations/openai-python-sdk.md)
- [Vercel AI SDK v5](https://apidocs.mor.org/documentation/integrations/vercel-ai-sdk-integration.md)
- [LangChain](https://apidocs.mor.org/documentation/integrations/langchain.md)
- [OpenCode](https://apidocs.mor.org/documentation/integrations/opencode.md)
- [Cursor](https://apidocs.mor.org/documentation/integrations/cursor.md)

## This kit

- [README](README.md): quick start, code snippets, lanes
- [MORPHEUS.md](MORPHEUS.md): full human-readable resource index
- [Gateway setup](morpheus/SETUP.md): API features and gaps, model choice, routing coding agents
- [Run a node](morpheus/NODE.md): consumer node setup and security
- [Preflight script](morpheus/preflight.sh): tests a key, models, latency and tool calls
- [Vendor guard](morpheus/no-other-vendors.sh): fails if code calls another AI vendor directly

## Templates

- [morpheus-chatbot](https://github.com/MorpheusAIs/morpheus-chatbot): Next.js chatbot template
- [morpheus-coding-agent](https://github.com/MorpheusAIs/morpheus-coding-agent): multi-agent coding template
- [morpheus-open-agents](https://github.com/MorpheusAIs/morpheus-open-agents): cloud-agent template
- [morpheus-knowledge-agent](https://github.com/MorpheusAIs/morpheus-knowledge-agent): knowledge-base agent template
- [x402-playground](https://github.com/MorpheusAIs/x402-playground): x402 paid-API chat app
- [api-gateway-typescript-sdk](https://github.com/MorpheusAIs/api-gateway-typescript-sdk): TypeScript SDK
